title_zh: 京张开源脉冲连续参与与回传日志
title_en: Open Pulse continuous participation and return log
author: 许丙南
authority_boundary: This is a process and evidence ledger, not proof of resident consent, a permit, a public consultation result or implementation approval.
cycle_rule: sync inputs -> reread changed requirements -> compare peers -> validate the package -> publish a bounded review draft -> field and public baseline -> staffed window -> return evidence -> retain, redesign or retire

participant_lenses.fallback: ordinary rest, shade, help and route without app or account
participant_lenses.decision_output: route breaks, heat/rest conflicts and unresolved complaints

participant_lenses.group: wheelchair, cane, guide-dog and low-vision users
participant_lenses.fallback: continuous step-free route, audible/print information and human assistance
participant_lenses.decision_output: clear width, surface, glare, crossing, wayfinding and stop-gate findings

participant_lenses.fallback: non-screen play, rest and safe crossing
participant_lenses.decision_output: care burden, conflict points, noise and supervision findings

participant_lenses.fallback: low-glare physical guidance and staffed help
participant_lenses.decision_output: quiet-chain, lighting, safety and night-service findings

participant_lenses.fallback: legible signs, map and human referral
participant_lenses.decision_output: orientation, language, cultural interpretation and public-state clarity

participant_lenses.group: small businesses, developers and university teams
participant_lenses.fallback: ordinary service desk and non-AI process
participant_lenses.decision_output: scenario usefulness, data/rights boundary and enterprise test evidence

participant_lenses.fallback: passive component, manual inspection and safe shutdown
participant_lenses.decision_output: access for cleaning/repair, spares, staffing, shutdown and reinstatement

evidence: README, brief, taskbook and package validators reread
event_log.decision: keep current geometry and field values provisional/unknown; refresh after every upstream change
package may enter formal review when repository CI and maintainer queue are available
add a distinct construction-readiness and participation artifact without copying peer geometry, quantities or text
do not infer resident consent, microclimate performance, accessibility pass or health outcome
requires permits, staffed fallback, visible state, rights record, baseline and stop/takeover rehearsal

public_return_requirements: publish the question, boundary, responsible person and what is not being claimed
support participant time and offer paper, staffed, multilingual and no-app channels
return a decision with reasons, negative findings, group differences and unresolved dissent
delete or retain only the minimum authorized data and publish the retention decision
record maintenance, complaint, safety, rights and ordinary-route effects before scale-up
issue an explicit retain, redesign or retire decision and restore ordinary public use on exit

privacy_and_rights.consent_and_withdrawal: required for testimony, images, attributable contributions and any non-essential observation
privacy_and_rights.source_and_rights_record: visual/assets/copyright-ledger.json plus the public status board

next_authorized_checks: confirm official geometry, ownership, heritage, road, water, utility and fire interfaces
co-design paired day/night accessibility routes with affected users
pre-register climate, drainage, quiet-chain and maintenance observations
run a passive/reversible mock-up before any connected or embodied-AI window
publish the first return memo before deciding whether any component remains
